unit_statements_verbatim:
# Electrical and Computer Engineering (BS)

---

The requirement for the degree is 128 units.

## University Requirements (28 units)

---

### Composition/Writing Requirements (8 units)

---

- WRIT 150 Writing and Critical Reasoning–Thematic Approaches Units: 4
- WRIT 340 Advanced Writing and Critical Engagement Units: 4

### General Education (20 units)

---

- General education Units: 20

## Pre-Major Requirements (30 units)

---

### Math Requirement (12 units)

---

- MATH 126g Calculus II Units: 4 or
- MATH 127 Enhanced Calculus II Units: 4 or
- MATH 129 Calculus II for Engineers and Scientists Units: 4 *
-
- MATH 226g Calculus III Units: 4 or
- MATH 227 Enhanced Calculus III Units: 4 or
- MATH 229 Calculus III for Engineers and Scientists Units: 4 *
-
- MATH 245 Mathematics of Physics and Engineering I Units: 4

### Physics Requirement (12 units)

---

- PHYS 151Lg Fundamentals of Physics I: Mechanics, Oscillations and Waves Units: 4 or
- PHYS 161Lg Advanced Principles of Physics I Units: 4
-
- PHYS 152L Fundamentals of Physics II: Electricity and Magnetism Units: 4 or
- PHYS 162L Advanced Principles of Physics II Units: 4
-
- PHYS 153L Fundamentals of Physics III: Optics, Thermo, Modern Physics Units: 4 or
- PHYS 163L Advanced Principles of Physics III Units: 4

### Biology Requirement (4 units)

---

Each of the following courses will satisfy both the BS ECE biology requirement and the General Education GE-D requirement.

Choose one from this list:

- BISC 104Lgx How the Body Works Units: 4
- BISC 120Lg General Biology: Organismal Biology and Evolution Units: 4
- BISC 121Lg Advanced General Biology: Organismal Biology and Evolution Units: 4
- BISC 220Lg General Biology: Cell Biology and Physiology Units: 4
- BISC 221Lg Advanced General Biology: Cell Biology and Physiology Units: 4
- BISC 230Lgx The Biology of the Brain Units: 4
- HBIO 205Lgx The Science of Sport Units: 4

### Engineering (2 units)

---

- ENGR 102 Viterbi First-Year Academy Units: 2

## Major Requirements (64 units)

---

### Electrical and Computer Engineering (44 units)

---

- EE 105 Introduction to Electrical Engineering Units: 4
- EE 109L Introduction to Embedded Systems Units: 4
- EE 141L Applied Linear Algebra for Engineering Units: 4
- EE 155L Introduction to Computer Programming for Electrical Engineers Units: 4
- EE 202L Linear Circuits Units: 4
- EE 250L Distributed Systems for the Internet of Things Units: 4
- EE 301 Linear Systems Units: 4
- EE 355x Software Design for Electrical Engineers Units: 4
- EE 364 Probability and Statistics for Engineers and Computer Scientists Units: 4
- EE 370L Electromagnetics for Engineering Systems Units: 4
- EE 460 Machine Learning for Engineers Units: 4

### Capstone Design Course (4 units)

---

- EE 496 Capstone Design Units: 4
- Students pursuing substantial research with a faculty advisor may request department approval to take EE 494a and EE 494b Undergraduate Thesis (2 units each) to satisfy the Capstone requirement.

### Electrical and Computer Engineering Electives (16 units)

---

Students must fulfill a minimum requirement of 16 units of adviser-approved upper-division elective courses in electrical engineering.

## Free Electives (6 units)

---

Free elective courses are used to complete the university minimum 128-unit requirement.

notes.text: The requirement for the degree is 128 units. A cumulative grade point average of C (2.0) is required for all courses taken at USC as well as all upper-division courses applied toward the major, regardless of the department in which the courses are taken. See also the common requirements for undergraduate degrees section.
